seo.title: Lufthansa Group: Cognigy conversational agents - 16 million conversations per year (2024)
seo.meta_description: The Lufthansa group runs its customer service assistants on Cognigy and handles 16 million conversations per year, with peaks at 375,000 interactions per day, in several languages.
seo.resume_citable: The Lufthansa group handles 16 million conversations per year on the Cognigy platform, with peaks of up to 375,000 interactions per day, for rebooking and multilingual customer service.

faq.q: What technology powers Lufthansa's AI customer service?
faq.a: The Cognigy conversational AI platform, with real-time translation, for the Lufthansa hub airlines, Austrian Airlines and SWISS.

faq.q: What volume does Lufthansa's AI handle?
faq.a: About 16 million conversations per year, with peaks of up to 375,000 interactions in a single high-demand day.

objectif_business: Replace a rigid internal chatbot, overwhelmed by demand spikes during and after covid, with a platform able to absorb millions of conversations in several languages and free up agents for complex cases.
description: The Lufthansa group runs its digital assistants on the Cognigy platform for the hub airlines (Lufthansa, Austrian Airlines, SWISS). A customer can ask a question on the site, in live chat, by SMS or by voice, in their language, and the agent handles common tasks: rebooking, travel information, alternative flight search, refund request. Real-time translation makes it possible to serve an international audience on a single foundation. When the request goes beyond what can be automated, it is handed off to a human advisor.
points_cles: Multilingual customer service conversational agents across the Lufthansa hub airlines.
Cognigy.AI platform, NLU, real-time translation, chat, SMS and voice channels.
16 million conversations per year, peaks of up to 375,000 interactions per day.
Evidence B, confirmed status: Cognigy case study and interview with the product manager.

resultats.metrique: Conversations handled per year with the AI
Interaction peak on a high-demand day
Reported annual split: about 10M in chat, over 1M in voice

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified Cognigy platform case study (annual volume and daily peak), complemented by a public interview with the Lufthansa product manager (VUX World) detailing the chat and voice scale. Hard figures on the vendor side, corroborated by the executive's statements.

stack_technique.detail: enterprise conversational AI platform (NLU, dialog orchestration) that powers the hub airlines' assistants, 16 million conversations per year
the same conversational foundation exposed in live chat (about 10M interactions per year), SMS and voice (over 1M per year)
makes it possible to serve a multilingual international audience with a single dialog foundation
real-time access to booking records, flight status and inventory for rebooking; the critical signal during a crisis

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time, continuous, with seasonal and crisis peaks (weather, strikes) that multiply the volume.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Lufthansa group's Digital Assistants team, on the Cognigy platform.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The customer's intent crossed with the state of their booking and the availability of alternative flights. If the inventory and flight-status feed degrades during a crisis, the rebooking proposals become wrong just as the volume explodes.

etapes.detail: The customer writes or speaks on the site, in live chat, by SMS or by voice, in their language.
The agent identifies the intent and applies real-time translation for a single multilingual foundation.
Rebooking, travel information, alternative flight search or refund are executed or prepared.
Complex or sensitive cases are passed to an advisor with the conversation context.

prerequis_data: real-time access to flight status and inventory
prerequis_orga: product team dedicated to the assistants
ability to hold the load during crisis peaks
replication.equipe: 1 assistants product manager + 2-3 conversational and integration devs + the customer service teams for the escalation journeys

playbook.action: Frame the priority use cases (rebooking, travel information, refund) on one channel and one language
Connect the booking systems, flight status and inventory
playbook.livrable: Real-time connectors tested, including in degraded mode

playbook.action: Build and launch the agent in live chat with escalation to an advisor, conversation context passed along
playbook.livrable: v1 agent in production on one channel, resolution rate measured

playbook.action: Extend languages via real-time translation and add SMS then voice
Test load handling on peaks (weather, strikes) and industrialize measurement
playbook.livrable: Capacity plan + volume, resolution, AHT dashboard

replication.premiere_etape: Deploy an agent on one channel (live chat) and one language for rebooking, then extend to the other languages and channels.

statut_vivant.note: Agents in production across the Lufthansa hub airlines, with an annual volume on the order of 16 million conversations documented by the vendor.

transposable_ue.note: Already deployed in the EU (Lufthansa group airlines, Austrian Airlines, SWISS). The GDPR and AI Act constraints are therefore built into execution: AI disclosure, consent management for voice, minimization of the booking data processed.
